frey.definition: n. (Norse mythology) god of earth's fertility and peace and prosperity; son of Njorth and brother of Freya; originally of the Vanir; later with the Aesir
frey.translation: n. 弗雷(兴旺、爱情、和平之神)

frey's hairs.translation: [医] 弗莱氏毛(检皮压痛觉)

frey's syndrome.translation: [医] 弗莱氏综合征, 耳颞神经综合征

frey-gigon's method.translation: [医] 弗-吉二氏法(检氨基酸氮)

freya.definition: n. (Norse mythology) goddess of love and fecundity; daughter of Njorth and sister of Frey
freya.translation: n. 弗雷娅(爱与春天女神)

freyberg.translation: n. (Freyberg)人名；(英)弗赖伯格；(瑞典)弗赖贝里；(德)弗赖贝格

freyer's operation.translation: [医] 弗里尔氏手术(耻骨上前列腺剜出术)

freyr.definition: n (Norse mythology) god of earth's fertility and peace and prosperity; son of Njorth and brother of Freya; originally of the Vanir; later with the Aesir
freyr.translation: n. 司丰饶和平及耕耘之神
